headline: Handmade with love, made to make you smile
tagline: Cute hair accessories and little gifts, made by hand in Sylhet
story: Hi, I'm Nusrat! I started Sweet Pea Studio from my bedroom table with a pack of ribbons and a lot of patience. Every hair band, scrunchie and keychain is made by hand, one at a time, with soft fabrics and happy colours. I hope they bring a little joy to your day.
sellingPoints: 100% handmade, no two are exactly alike
goodToKnow: Delivery takes 2 to 3 days inside Sylhet and 4 to 6 days outside Sylhet
Colours may look slightly different on your screen
Exchange within 3 days if the item arrives damaged
Custom colours and bulk orders are welcome, just message us
paymentNote: Cash on delivery, or bKash 01XXXXXXXXX (send money, then share the transaction ID on WhatsApp).
